name: 2pcs Rugby Ball Squishy Stress Relief Ball
description:
Product type: Squishy Ball 2 pcs 
Made in china 
Whether in search of stress relief toys / relievers or a new fidget toy, our squishy balls are perfect. Smoosh, squeeze, stretch, pull, toss, bounce - they will immediately return to their original shape. Simple squishy stress ball stress relief! 
Made with 100% high-quality thermoplastic rubber, they are hypoallergenic, nontoxic, and free of BPAs, phthalates and latex. Our stress relief balls are strong, durable and safe - great stress balls for kids AND adults. Makes for a great gift! 
Perfect for the classroom, home or office, they're great for teachers, students and anyone else. A great alternative to mesh, bead and other squishy balls. 
Squishy stress ball relief is useful for all children and adults, but especially those with ADD/ADHD, OCD, autism, or high anxiety levels. These toys help promote a sense of calm, reduce stress / anxiety and can increase focus / attention. 
Unlike many other stress relief balls, these are highly tear-resistant and WILL NOT break open. By using unique production methods, we have created a pliable, stretchable 100% TPR ball that is a great alternative to other stress relief balls
